checks.assertions: Native execution checks all physical stack guards, DP domains, ownership and OS restoration; expected faults retain guards. C checks live locals, computation, message identity and lower DP. Capacity cases check full native register/width restoration.
checks.physical_io: Two live large workers, CON: output and exact 128-byte SDFS read at profile 4 / generic56k; nonzero native IRQs and unchanged disk bytes.
checks.aperture: 0x8000..0x8fff sentinel preserved in Action! cases and OF816 routes; no mapped VBXE.
checks.observer_storage: Capacity register probe borrows 128 bytes at 0x7d00. Depth/C observers use debugger breakpoints and existing fields; C seeds existing lower DP workspace. Aperture sentinels use its existing reservation. Logical-floor injections are restored before domain checks.
checks.stack_measurement: Fresh boot fill 0xa5, no live refill. Reuse/Process cases report combined lifetime peaks; these are observed peaks, not whole-Task bounds.

code_size_scope: Task policy routine bytes match the baseline fixture per compiler mode. Adapter file sizes include padding. C shim object executable sections rebuilt from d8dbea4 sources with matching pinned tools/flags; exact bytes match, before link-time dead stripping. Larger C fixture code itself is additional test code.

comment_only_source_update.note: Added routine comments after execution; raw/optimized rebuilds are byte-identical. Earlier reports preserve their original source hashes.

of816.scope: Pinned Forth core for the experimental AltirraOS XEX boot monitor

pin.scope: Shell keyboard bridge plus host pacing only after completed video frames; guest CPU/peripheral timing is unchanged.

shell.scope: Shell boot, disk HELLO, CAT/WC pipeline and EXIT

demo.scope: Two boot/handoff+shell routes (five-second autoboot with clock wrap; final-second cancel/Forth with D2/cache override), plus BYE and occupied IOCB. Both shell routes run disk commands, pipeline and EXIT.

performance.note: Initialization timing and aggregate wall time were not instrumented; no performance claim. Native reports retain bounded frame/cycle observations where available. Comment-equivalence rebuilds record host wall time only.

limits: Development checks do not qualify the full hosted release.
C functions do not gain automatic stack-overflow checks.
GEM adapted call chains/link map and mapped VBXE remain untested.
Large pools can be occupied by small Tasks or Process reservations.
The 9408-byte free bank-zero range remains unregistered with the heap.
